title: Burnout Paradise Greatest Hits Sony PS3 2008 - Complete, VGC
descriptionText:
Experience the thrill of high-speed racing with Burnout Paradise Greatest Hits for Sony PlayStation 3. This game, released in 2008, features a rating of E10+ (Everyone 10+) and is part of the popular Burnout Series. With its engaging gameplay and stunning graphics, this racing game is a must-have for any racing fan.

This PS3 game comes complete in box (CIB) and is published by Electronic Arts. Its genre is racing and it is perfect for players of all skill levels. Get ready to rev your engines and hit the tracks with Burnout Paradise Greatest Hits.
